spans.text: [7] AR: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَكَانَ عَرْشُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْمَآءِ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۗ وَلَئِن قُلْتَ إِنَّكُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلْمَوْتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ EN: And it is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and His Throne had been upon water - that He might test you as to which of you is best in deed.

folded.id: and lost|is|what they did therein
folded.subject: And lost
folded.object: what they did therein

spans.text: And lost is what they did therein, and worthless is what they used to do.

folded.id: and there|is|no creature on earth but that upon allah is its provision
folded.subject: And there
folded.object: no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision

spans.text: [6] AR: ۞ وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا ۚ كُلٌّۭ فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ EN: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage.

[18] AR: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ أَلَا لَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ EN: And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah?

folded.id: before it|was|the scripture of moses to lead and as mercy
folded.subject: before it
folded.object: the Scripture of Moses to lead and as mercy

spans.text: And a witness from Him follows it, and before it was the Scripture of Moses to lead and as mercy.

folded.id: but you|are|only a warner
folded.subject: But you
folded.object: only a warner

spans.text: But you are only a warner.

folded.id: from them|is|what they used to invent
folded.subject: from them
folded.object: what they used to invent

spans.text: [21] AR: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ EN: Those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.

folded.id: he|is|despairing and ungrateful
folded.subject: he
folded.object: despairing and ungrateful

spans.text: [9] AR: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةًۭ ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَٰهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَـُٔوسٌۭ كَفُورٌۭ EN: And if We give man a taste of mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him, indeed, he is despairing and ungrateful.

folded.id: he|is|exultant and boastful -
folded.subject: he
folded.object: exultant and boastful -

spans.text: Indeed, he is exultant and boastful -

folded.id: he|is|knowing of that within the breasts
folded.subject: He
folded.object: Knowing of that within the breasts

spans.text: Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

folded.id: if we|give|man a taste of mercy from us and then we withdraw it from him
folded.subject: if We
folded.object: man a taste of mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him

spans.text: [9] AR: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةًۭ ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَٰهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَـُٔوسٌۭ كَفُورٌۭ EN: And if We give man a taste of mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him, indeed, he is despairing and ungrateful.

[10] AR: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَٰهُ نَعْمَآءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتُ عَنِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَفَرِحٌۭ فَخُورٌ EN: But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me."

folded.id: if we|hold|back from them the punishment for a limited time
folded.subject: if We
folded.object: back from them the punishment for a limited time

spans.text: [8] AR: وَلَئِنْ أَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ مَّعْدُودَةٍۢ لَّيَقُولُنَّ مَا يَحْبِسُهُۥٓ ۗ أَلَا يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمْ لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا عَنْهُمْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ EN: And if We hold back from them the punishment for a limited time, they will surely say, "What detains it?"

folded.id: it|is|the truth from your lord
folded.subject: it
folded.object: the truth from your Lord

spans.text: Indeed, it is the truth from your Lord, but most of the people do not believe.

folded.id: it|is|they in the hereafter who will be the greatest losers
folded.subject: it
folded.object: they in the Hereafter who will be the greatest losers

spans.text: [22] AR: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ EN: Assuredly, it is they in the Hereafter who will be the greatest losers.

folded.id: of allah|is|upon the wrongdoers
folded.subject: of Allah
folded.object: upon the wrongdoers

spans.text: Unquestionably, the curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers.

folded.id: of what|is|revealed to you
folded.subject: of what
folded.object: revealed to you

spans.text: [12] AR: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۢ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَضَآئِقٌۢ بِهِۦ صَدْرُكَ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُۥ مَلَكٌ ۚ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ نَذِيرٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَكِيلٌ EN: Then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you, or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "Why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?"

folded.id: or|is|your breast constrained by it because they say
folded.subject: or
folded.object: your breast constrained by it because they say

spans.text: [12] AR: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۢ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَضَآئِقٌۢ بِهِۦ صَدْرُكَ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُۥ مَلَكٌ ۚ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ نَذِيرٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَكِيلٌ EN: Then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you, or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "Why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?"

folded.id: so|is|one who [stands] upon a clear evidence from his lord [like the aforementioned]?
folded.subject: So
folded.object: one who [stands] upon a clear evidence from his Lord [like the aforementioned]?

spans.text: [17] AR: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌۭ مِّنْهُ وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًۭا وَرَحْمَةً ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ فَٱلنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُۥ ۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: So is one who [stands] upon a clear evidence from his Lord [like the aforementioned]?

folded.id: term and|give|every doer of favor his favor
folded.subject: term and
folded.object: every doer of favor his favor

spans.text: [3] AR: وَأَنِ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُم مَّتَٰعًا حَسَنًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِى فَضْلٍۢ فَضْلَهُۥ ۖ وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍۢ كَبِيرٍ EN: And [saying], "Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, [and] He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor.

folded.id: the fire|is|his promised destination
folded.subject: the Fire
folded.object: his promised destination

spans.text: But whoever disbelieves in it from the [various] factions - the Fire is his promised destination.

folded.id: the qur'an|was|revealed with the knowledge of allah and that there is no deity except him
folded.subject: the Qur'an
folded.object: revealed with the knowledge of Allah and that there is no deity except Him

spans.text: [14] AR: فَإِلَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ بِعِلْمِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ EN: And if they do not respond to you - then know that the Qur'an was revealed with the knowledge of Allah and that there is no deity except Him.

folded.id: these|are|the ones who lied against their lord
folded.subject: These
folded.object: the ones who lied against their Lord

spans.text: Those will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied against their Lord."

folded.id: this|is|not but obvious magic
folded.subject: This
folded.object: not but obvious magic

spans.text: But if you say, "Indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "This is not but obvious magic."

folded.id: those who|are|patient and do righteous deeds
folded.subject: those who
folded.object: patient and do righteous deeds

spans.text: [11] AR: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ EN: Except for those who are patient and do righteous deeds; those will have forgiveness and great reward.

folded.id: those|are|the ones for whom there is not in the hereafter but the fire
folded.subject: Those
folded.object: the ones for whom there is not in the Hereafter but the Fire

spans.text: [16] AR: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِلَّا ٱلنَّارُ ۖ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوا۟ فِيهَا وَبَٰطِلٌۭ مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ EN: Those are the ones for whom there is not in the Hereafter but the Fire.
[21] AR: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ EN: Those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.

folded.id: to allah|is|your return
folded.subject: To Allah
folded.object: your return

spans.text: [4] AR: إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ EN: To Allah is your return, and He is over all things competent."

folded.id: whose verses|are|perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] wise and acquainted
folded.subject: whose verses
folded.object: perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] Wise and Acquainted

spans.text: [This is] a Book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] Wise and Acquainted.

folded.id: why|has|there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?"
folded.subject: Why
folded.object: there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?"

spans.text: [12] AR: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۢ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَضَآئِقٌۢ بِهِۦ صَدْرُكَ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُۥ مَلَكٌ ۚ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ نَذِيرٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَكِيلٌ EN: Then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you, or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "Why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?"

folded.id: you|are|resurrected after death
folded.subject: you
folded.object: resurrected after death

spans.text: But if you say, "Indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "This is not but obvious magic."
